decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area.)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenities of the neighbouring residential property against increased overlooking with resultant loss of privacy.)

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents)

Condition : 6 - 9.1	The proposed single storey rear extension would not be harmful to neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the surrounding area. The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
